source_location: main-4 (p. 9510), left column, Results section 3 ("A large desorption peak (corresponding to ca. 2.3 wt % H2) centered at 541 C is seen for the sample Ni20(arc)"), Figure 5; also right column ("decreased from initial 2.3 wt %"), Figure 7
